subject.title: Telegram delivery should be idempotent across message.send, final replies, and resumed turns

question: When a same-target message-tool send succeeds, should automatic delivery suppress only equivalent final payloads, or every later visible final from that logical turn including distinct text?
rationale: Current tests intentionally preserve distinct same-target finals, while the requested at-most-once invariant could redefine those finals as duplicates and silently remove legitimate follow-ups.

options.title: Keep equivalent-only suppression
options.body: Preserve current exact route-aware behavior and require a concrete current-main trace before adding a targeted guard for a specific bypass path.

options.title: Suppress all same-turn finals
options.body: Treat any successful same-target tool send as terminal visible delivery and discard all later automatic finals from that turn.

options.title: Add durable delivery receipts
options.body: Design persisted logical-turn receipts spanning retry and resume boundaries, with explicit identities and migration/lifecycle ownership rather than semantic text matching.

recommendation.title: Keep equivalent-only suppression
recommendation.body: Preserve current exact route-aware behavior and require a concrete current-main trace before adding a targeted guard for a specific bypass path.
